points.group: same tile, surface and kind, within each sealed split; ALS origin shared across all buildings and both splits of that surface
points.grid: LoD2 normalized source tangents and face minimum; ALS XY minimum of all regular inherited patches on that tile/surface/kind; floor((coord-origin)/0.5+1e-7)
points.grid_check: distance to nearest 0.25 m integer offset <=1e-5 m; non-grid faces use tangent plane; extras attach closest point within 0.5 m in same surface/kind/split or singleton
points.tangent1: first source tangent projected orthogonal to mean normal then normalized
points.undefined: keep patch ownership; missing source normal/tangent remains unavailable and yields no eligible photos; never infer from GT
points.building: largest contributing area as primary building; ALS building_ids records every contributor; patch-level tables retain each original building; shared-cell split at development/holdout boundary only

metadata.sigma_assignment: At the query centre, nearest 3D training patch centre; invalid or missing source sigma uses that unit/source finite median. No validity probability or GT fields are read.
metadata.crop_reason: Only discard points farther in XY than the global maximum possible MVS radius from the application footprint bbox
